_why: The spec published by Asaas omits the AUTHORIZED status from ALL 7 charge status enums. It exists in practice: it is the state of a card charge created with `authorizeOnly: true` (pre-authorization), documented in prose in /reference/capturar-cobranca-com-pre-autorizacao and emitted as the PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED event. Without this overlay, the response validation would reject a legitimate pre-authorized charge. The file spec/openapi.json stays untouched so the drift diff against upstream stays clean.
